meta.name: made-to-stick
meta.description: Craft messages that are understood, remembered, and drive action using the SUCCESs checklist (Simple, Unexpected, Concrete, Credible, Emotional, Stories). Use when the user mentions "make it memorable", "no one remembers our pitch", "tagline", "value proposition", "why the message isnt landing", "curse of knowledge", or "concrete language". Also trigger when writing a pitch deck, simplifying a complex product explanation, or making a presentation more compelling. Covers the six SUCCESs traits and the curse of knowledge. For narrative brand frameworks, see storybrand-messaging. For viral sharing, see contagious.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让信息被记住并驱动行动
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让你的信息更易理解和传播
copy.tagline_en: Make messages memorable and drive action
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your messages to be understood and remembered

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 SUCCESs 框架（简单、意外、具体、可信、情感、故事）帮你把信息改得更易理解、好记、能促进行动。它会先给信息打分，再针对低分项给出具体修改建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“让信息好记”“没人记住我们的提案”“标语”“价值主张”“信息为什么没效果”“知识的诅咒”“具体语言”，或要求写 pitch deck、简化复杂产品说明、让演示更吸引人时触发。

say.text: 我们的产品介绍没人记住，帮我改得更好记。
say.note: Claude 会用 SUCCESs 框架分析并给出修改建议。

say.text: 帮我写一个产品标语，要简单、意外、具体。
say.note: Claude 会生成符合 SUCCESs 原则的标语。

say.text: 这个演示文稿太抽象了，帮我改得更具体。
say.note: Claude 会替换抽象表述为具体细节。
